hints.title: Tree Structure and Operations
hints.text: At each node, we either take (coins[u] >> c) - k, or floor((coins[u] >> c) / 2) which increments the halving count c for all descendants.

hints.title: Halving Threshold Bound
hints.text: Since coins[u] <= 10^4, right shifting 14 times reduces any coin value to 0, so c only needs to be tracked from 0 up to 14.

hints.title: Tree Subproblem Memoization
hints.text: Use DFS with memoization state (u, c), returning the maximum total points collected from subtree u given ancestor halving count c.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Tree DFS with bounded halving states up to 14.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that coin values become 0 after at most 14 divisions.
